#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

bool good(long long p[][5], int n, int i) {
    for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
        if (j == i) continue;
        for (int k = j + 1; k < n; ++k) {
            if (k == i) continue;
            long long dot = (p[j][0] - p[i][0]) * (p[k][0] - p[i][0])
                         + (p[j][1] - p[i][1]) * (p[k][1] - p[i][1])
                         + (p[j][2] - p[i][2]) * (p[k][2] - p[i][2])
                         + (p[j][3] - p[i][3]) * (p[k][3] - p[i][3])
                         + (p[j][4] - p[i][4]) * (p[k][4] - p[i][4]);
            if (dot > 0) return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    if (n > 11) {
        cout << "0\n";
        return 0;
    }

    vector<vector<long long>> points(n, vector<long long>(5));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> points[i][0] >> points[i][1] >> points[i][2] >> points[i][3] >> points[i][4];
    }

    vector<int> ret;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        long long arr[5];
        for (int d = 0; d < 5; ++d) arr[d] = points[i][d];
        // Wrap points into a 2D array compatible with good()
        // We create a static 2D array copy for each call
        long long p[100][5];
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
            for (int d = 0; d < 5; ++d)
                p[j][d] = points[j][d];
        if (good(p, n, i)) ret.push_back(i + 1);
    }

    cout << ret.size() << "\n";
    for (int x : ret) {
        cout << x << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}
